verdict.rationale: AnyDesk documents CLI scripting and a REST API for automating installation, configuration, sessions and data retrieval. Nothing in the evidence shows the product itself versioning, reviewing, or rolling back those automations. User-maintained scripts and the adaptable open-source Python module are user-side workarounds and building blocks, not a product capability, so the applicable axis earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
